rationale: The original short thesis relied on price remaining beneath both the 5-minute 9-EMA and session VWAP, both of which have now been reclaimed ($277.19 and $278.93 respectively, with price at $278.99). Five consecutive 1-minute green candles demonstrate relative strength against a worsening broader market (SPY down -2.61%), invalidating the bearish continuation setup. However, declining volume on the bounce, wide spreads (20.1 bps), and severe macro headwinds make flipping to long unattractive, making a clean exit the optimal choice.
